ov: Large plant-eating lizards of tropical America, with a dewlap and a crest of long scales down the back. The green iguana is widespread and a popular pet; the other species lives only in the Lesser Antilles.

why.p: The green iguana is a popular pet, and it has been introduced well beyond its native range, including Florida and Hawaii.
why.et: Iguana meat is traditional in Mexico and Central America and also eaten in the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico. The eggs are eaten in places too.

rg: Tropical Mexico, Central America, South America and the Caribbean; introduced to Florida, Hawaii and parts of Asia.
fx: A female can store sperm for several years.
notes: Two species. The existing fact (light-sensing third eye on top of its head) is confirmed: the parietal eye.
